camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --Comment cpp --DatabaseType MySQL --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-7mz2g5hu20e' --PolarDBEndpointType Cluster --DatabaseName Test01 --InstanceMemberId 1605494 --SourceInstanceId 'i-bp19ienyt0yax7480000' --Source Local --ActiveAddressType Public --DatabasePort 5433 --DatabasePrivateAddress '192.168.XX.XX' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DatabasePublicAddress 'www.example.com' --SourceInstanceRegionId 'cn-shanghai' --NetworkDomainId 1
description_en: Imports a database into a Bastionhost instance for centralized O&M management. Supported databases include ApsaraDB RDS, PolarDB, and self-managed MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle databases
description_zh: 您可以通过本接口，将MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL类型的RDS和MySQL、PostgreSQL、PostgreSQL（兼容Oracle）的PolarDB以及MySQL、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、Oracle类型的自建数据库资产导入至堡垒机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-database --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2g5hu20e --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 1 --database-type MySQL --active-address-type Public --database-private-address 192.168.XX.XX --database-public-address www.example.com --database-port 5433 --database-name Test01 --source-instance-id i-bp19ienyt0yax7480000 --source Local --comment cpp --source-instance-region-id cn-shanghai --polar-db-endpoint-type Cluster --instance-member-id 1605494 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For a list of region IDs and their corresponding region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network domain for the new database.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建数据库所属的网络域ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758827.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: network_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

- **MySQL**

- **Oracle**

- **PostgreSQL**

- **SQLServer**
parameters.name: database_type

parameters.help_en:
The address type of the new database. Valid values:

- Public: a public endpoint

- Private: a private endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建数据库的地址类型。取值：

- Public：公网地址
- Private：私网地址
parameters.name: active_address_type

parameters.help_en:
The private endpoint of the database. You can use an IPv4 address or a domain name.

> This parameter is required if you set ActiveAddressType to Private
parameters.help_zh:
私网地址。支持IPv4地址和域名格式。
>ActiveAddressType选择Private时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_private_address

parameters.help_en:
The public endpoint of the database. You can use an IPv4 address or a domain name.

> This parameter is required if you set ActiveAddressType to Public
parameters.help_zh:
公网地址。支持IPv4地址和域名格式。
>ActiveAddressType选择Public时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_public_address

parameters.help_en: The port used to connect to the database. This parameter is required if you set Source to **Local**
parameters.help_zh: 数据库的访问端口。数据库来源为**Local**，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the new database instance. This parameter is required if you set Source to **Local**
parameters.help_zh: 新创建的数据库实例名称。数据库来源为**Local**，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database instance.

> This parameter is required if you set **Source** to **Rds** or **PolarDB**
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的数据库实例ID。  
> **Source**选择**Rds**或**PolarDB**时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The source of the new database. Valid values:

- Local: a local database instance

- Rds: an RDS database instance

- PolarDB: a PolarDB database instance
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建数据库的来源。取值：
- Local：本地数据库实例
- Rds：RDS类型数据库实例
- PolarDB: PolarDB类型数据库实例
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The comments on the new database. The comments can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建的数据库的备注信息。最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the database instance.

> This parameter is required if **Source** is set to **Rds** or **PolarDB**
parameters.help_zh:
指定新创建的数据库实例所属地域ID。
>**Source**为**Rds**或**PolarDB**时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required if you set Source to PolarDB. This parameter specifies the endpoint type of the PolarDB database. Valid values:

- Cluster: a cluster endpoint

- Primary: a primary endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
Source为PolarDB时必传，表示PolarDB的Endpoint类型，取值：
- Cluster：集群地址
- Primary：主地址
parameters.name: polar_db_endpoint_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the new RDS or PolarDB database instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建的RDS、PolarDB数据库实例所属的主账号ID
parameters.name: instance_member_id
